act.name: Legal Metrology Act, 2009
act.source_authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
act.description: Central law regulating weights, measures and goods sold by weight, measure or number.

sections.title: Declarations on pre-packaged commodities.
sections.text: Section 18 concerns prescribed declarations on pre-packaged commodities; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: Packaged goods must carry prescribed quantity and other declarations and comply with legal-metrology requirements.
